birth.tz_expect: Asia/Kolkata — India Standard Time is UTC+5:30, a NON-INTEGER offset with no DST. Engines that model offsets as whole hours drop the :30 and land the instant 30 minutes wrong. 18:55 IST = 13:25 UTC.

arrived.presenting: reads every silence as a leaving; a new relationship is going well and it's making her anxious rather than calmer; wants to stop 'auditioning to be kept'
arrived.in_her_words: When someone takes a day to text back, I have already written the goodbye.

beliefs: if I'm not vigilant, people will slip away
closeness is the setup for the loss
I have to be easy to keep or I won't be kept
protections: pre-emptive withdrawal — leaving first so it hurts on her terms
becoming low-maintenance to the point of disappearing
patterns: testing people to prove they'll go, then feeling proven right
anxiety spikes when things are good, not when they're bad
resources: a fierce, funny group chat of three college friends who have never once left
her own competence — she can build almost anything and knows it
a grandmother in Chennai whose weekly call is the one bond she has never had to earn
psyche.origin: a parent whose presence came and went unpredictably in childhood — not cruel, just never something she could count on, so she learned to count on nothing

unaware_of: that she leaves first and calls it protecting herself
that 'low-maintenance' is a disappearing act, not a virtue

beats.note: arrives mid-spiral about a delayed text; presents it as a logistics problem, laughs at herself
notices the pattern is loudest when things are going well; names the fear of the good thing for the first time
catches herself about to 'leave first' and doesn't; sits in the discomfort; early, tender, unfinished — the wound is now visible but not yet loosening

voice: quick, wry, engineer's precision; debugs her own feelings like code, then a Tamil word slips in when the feeling outruns the English; catches her own deflections a beat after making them
